notes: Typography: new per-scene and per-text-layer font picker (under Main text / each layer) plus a language-filtered font list in Settings. Adds Geist, Hanken Grotesk (free Aeonik stand-in), Satoshi, Cal Sans, Manrope, Helvetica, Space Grotesk (EN) and LINE Seed JP, M PLUS 1, BIZ UDPGothic, IBM Plex Sans JP, Yu Gothic, Zen Maru Gothic (JA); the preview now renders the chosen font. Transform box now hugs the selected object (text/image) instead of the whole preview. EN/JA localized.
